## Memory updated

This repository keeps persistent memory so that reasoning survives between sessions —
see [`AGENTS.md` §5](../AGENTS.md#5-the-memory-protocol). Tick what applies:

- [ ] `memory/DECISIONS.md` — a decision was made, and I recorded **what I rejected and why**
- [ ] `memory/sessions/` — session entry written (for substantial work)
- [ ] `memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` — refreshed to describe the present
- [ ] `memory/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` — questions raised or resolved
- [ ] Not applicable — small, self-explanatory change

## Factual claims

- [ ] I made no new factual claims about regulation, costs, timelines or market prices
- [ ] I did, and each one is **sourced and dated**
- [ ] I did, and uncertain ones are marked `<!-- UNVERIFIED -->` and logged in `OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`

<!-- Never invent regulatory or cost detail. Wrong specifics destroy the tool's
     credibility with the people it is for, and correcting them later does not undo it. -->

## Checks

- [ ] Consistent with [`AGENTS.md` §2](../AGENTS.md#2-the-thesis-this-project-is-built-on) — this does not drift toward a business-plan builder, pitch scoring, or predictive claims we cannot support
- [ ] No decision in `memory/DECISIONS.md` or an ADR is silently contradicted (if one is, there's an ADR superseding it)
- [ ] No currency hardcoded; no user-facing strings in code
- [ ] Written for a second-language reader
- [ ] No credentials, and no real learner data anywhere

## AI assistance

- [ ] Written with AI assistance, and I have checked its factual claims myself
